```{r}

data <- read_excel("/Users/brandonk28/Development/PAYT-Project/data/trashpopulations.xlsx")
```

```{r}
#make municipality lower case

data <- data %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(municipality = tolower(municipality))


```

```{r}
paystart <- read_excel("/Users/brandonk28/Development/PAYT-Project/data/paytstart.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(municipality = tolower(municipality))
```


```{r}
## **the n/a values for payt star year are municipalites that did not have payt programs**
merged_data <- data %>%
  left_join(paystart, by = "municipality")

```


```{r}
#dropped n/a vlalues for start year, we used MA PAYT spreadsheet given that the numbers were robust, non rounded, and provided greater accuracuy for analysis, we strictly looked at trash services, and nothing about recycling
final_data <- merged_data %>%
  select (-c(households_served_by_municipal_recycling_program,
             trash_cart_size,
             recycling_cart_size,
             single_stream_recyclables_tons,
             start_date,
             population.y,
             total_households,
             trash_households_served,
             trash_service,
             recycling_households_served,
             recycling_service,
             recycling_frequency,
             x1st_option_dollar_amount,
             x1st_option_unit_size,
             x2nd_option_dollar_amount,
             x2nd_option_unit_size,
             x3rd_option_dollar_amount,
             x3rd_option_unit_size,
             type_of_unit_included_w_basic_service,
             number_units_included_per_year,
             hybrid_modified_payt_program, 
             recycling_type
             ))
```

```{r}
#change character into numeric value
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(trash_disposal_tonnage = as.numeric(trash_disposal_tonnage)) %>%
  mutate(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program = as.numeric(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program))
```


```{r}
#keep n/a values: for example, some of the data does not determine whether or not a payt is SMART and replace everythgin with "no data" to N/A value

#years_payt can be positive or negative as it subtracts the survey year from the payt start year

final_data_clean <- final_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "no data"))) %>%
  mutate(PAYT = ifelse(is.na(payt_start_year), 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(years_payt = (survey_year - payt_start_year)) %>%
  mutate(trash_disposal_tonnage = as.numeric(trash_disposal_tonnage)) %>%
  mutate(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program = as.numeric(households_served_by_municipal_trash_program)) %>%
  mutate(tonnage_per_hh = trash_disposal_tonnage / households_served_by_municipal_trash_program)

```

```{r}
#do not inlcude bulky waste
no_bulk <- final_data_clean %>%
  filter(does_trash_disposal_tonnage_include_bulky_waste == "No",
         payt_start_year != 1900,
         !is.na(trash_disposal_tonnage))
       
```

```{r}
#standardize pre and post: for every given city, we will keep certain year to make a balanced panel of data
balanced_data <- no_bulk %>%  
  filter(abs(years_payt) <= 5)
```

```{r}
cities <- balanced_data %>%
  group_by(municipality) %>%
  count() %>%
  filter(n >= 10)

```

```{r}

#generate a mean for years_payt from 0-5 
post5 <- balanced_data %>%
  filter(municipality == "harvard" |
           municipality == "chicopee" |
           municipality == "heath" |
           municipality == "hinsdale"|
           municipality == "peru", 
         years_payt >= 0 & years_payt <=5) %>%
  group_by(municipality) %>%
  summarize(mean_post5 = mean(tonnage_per_hh, na.rm = TRUE))


#generate a mean for years_payt from -5 to -1
pre5 <- balanced_data %>%
  filter(municipality == "harvard" |
           municipality == "chicopee" |
           municipality == "heath" |
           municipality == "hinsdale"|
           municipality == "peru", 
         years_payt >= -5 & years_payt <= -1) %>%
  group_by(municipality) %>%
  summarize(mean_pre5 = mean(tonnage_per_hh, na.rm = TRUE))
 
difference <- pre5 %>%
  inner_join(post5, by = "municipality") %>%
  mutate(difference = mean_post5 - mean_pre5)

pre5_avg <- pre5 %>%
  summarize(overall_pre5 = mean(mean_pre5))

post5_avg <- post5 %>%
  summarize(overall_post5 = mean(mean_post5))

overall_avg <- (post5_avg$overall_post5 - pre5_avg$overall_pre5) 
overall_avg
```

```{r}
no_axes <- theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )


p1 <- ggplot(hinsdale,
       aes(x = years_payt,
           y = tonnage_per_hh)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap(

               width = 30),
    subtitle = "Years relative to PAYT start (Year 0)",
```

```{r}
clean_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 2)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

p1 <- p1 + clean_theme 
p2 <- p2 + clean_theme
p3 <- p3 + clean_theme
p4 <- p4 + clean_theme
p5 <- p5 + clean_theme

# 2) build rows so p5 spans full width
row1 <- plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 2, align = "hv")
row2 <- plot_grid(p3, p4, ncol = 2, align = "hv")
row3 <- plot_grid(p5, ncol = 1)

grid <- plot_grid(row1, row2, row3, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1, 1.2))


# 3) add GLOBAL axis labels at controlled size
final <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(grid, x = 0.08, y = 0.07, width = 0.92, height = .9) +
  draw_label(
    "Years Since PAYT Implementation",
    x = 0.54, y = 0.02,
    hjust = 0.5,
    size = 12
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Yearly Tonnage Per Household",
    x = 0.02, y = 0.52,
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 12
  )

final
ggsave("payt_panels.png", final, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```



```{r}
#city of malden revenue(asteric: does include bulky waste given data: city of boston would have to consider this)

malden <- final_data_clean %>%
  filter(municipality == "malden")

m_data <- read_excel("/Users/brandonk28/Development/PAYT-Project/data/malden_data.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(-c(x2,
            x2020, 
            x2019,
            x2021,
            x2024_anticipated,
            x11)) 




```
```{r}
#rename columns
colnames(m_data) <- c("source",
                      "2022", "2023", "2024", "2025")
                      
                      

#transform data from wide to long
m_data_long <- m_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("2022", "2023", "2024", "2025"),
               names_to = "year",
               values_to = "revenue")

colnames(m_data_long) <- c("source",
                      "survey_year",
                      "revenue")

m_data_long <- m_data_long %>%
  mutate(survey_year = as.numeric(survey_year))
```


```{r}

#make sure to include # of participating households for malden as a caveat: very dense city with a smaller population size than city of boston 

full_malden <- malden %>%
  inner_join(m_data_long, by = "survey_year") %>%
  group_by(source, survey_year) %>%
  summarize(
    hh_revenue = revenue / households_served_by_municipal_trash_program)
  

  





```
